title: Hallucinations of Large Language Models in Cross-Language Code Translation: Phenomena and Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27868v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code translation converts source code from one programming language to another while preserving its functionality. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have improved code translation, their outputs still contain hallucinations: generated code that conflicts with the source program, violates target-language facts, or introduces contextually inconsistent dependencies. These failures are especially harmful in translation because small semantic deviations can silently change program behavior. Existing hallucination studies mainly focus on natural-language generation or code generation, leaving the forms, distribution, and mitigation of hallucinations in cross-language code translation insufficiently characterized. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of LLM hallucinations in code translation. translated_title: 大语言模型在跨语言代码翻译中的幻觉：现象与缓解
translated_abstract: 代码翻译是将源代码从一种编程语言转换为另一种编程语言，同时保持其功能不变。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已经提升了代码翻译的效果，但其输出仍然包含幻觉：生成的代码与源程序冲突、违反目标语言的事实，或引入与上下文不一致的依赖项。这类失败在翻译任务中尤其有害，因为微小的语义偏差可能会悄然改变程序行为。现有的幻觉研究主要集中于自然语言生成或代码生成，而对跨语言代码翻译中幻觉的形式、分布及缓解措施的刻画尚不充分。本文对大语言模型在代码翻译中的幻觉进行了系统性的实证研究。在三个基准数据集、六个语言对和七个大语言模型上，我们构建了一个包含三大类别的分类体系：语义一致性……
tldr: 该论文对大语言模型在跨语言代码翻译中的幻觉现象开展了系统性实证研究，在三个基准数据集、六个语言对和七个大语言模型上构建了幻觉分类体系，并提出相应的缓解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic empirical study of LLM hallucinations in cross-language code translation, constructing a hallucination taxonomy across three benchmarks, six language pairs, and seven LLMs, along with mitigation strategies.
